package: Layout keepout - not a component package

layout_notes: Use antenna or module vendor keepout geometry.
Restrict copper pours, vias, traces, components, mounting hardware, and enclosure metal as required by the source document.

Ignoring enclosure plastic, metal, batteries, or cables near the antenna.

Do not claim antenna tuning is complete from a keepout placeholder.

notes: Use this record to force keepout documentation before RF layout release.
